row_counts.meaning: Rows read from the source workbook.
All source rows retained with quality flags.
Rows with a cancellation invoice marker or negative quantity; may overlap.
Positive quantity and unit price; valid invoice/date/customer identifiers; not cancellation-marked; not a non-product line; not an extra copy of an exact duplicate.
Rows not meeting the candidate cohort rules; retained in audit and exclusions output.
Valid cancelled/returned product lines subtracted from customer net spend.
Rows with one or more non-exclusion review flags; flags can overlap.

assumptions.cancellation_invoice: InvoiceNo starts with C, case-insensitive, per UCI documentation.
assumptions.return_like: Negative Quantity is separately flagged as return-like; this is a review signal, not a definitive UCI-coded return label.
assumptions.customer_sales_candidate: Positive Quantity and UnitPrice, valid six-digit invoice (optional C is excluded), parseable InvoiceDate, and valid five-digit CustomerID; all other rows remain in audit outputs.
assumptions.exact_duplicates: All copies stay flagged (row_is_exact_duplicate); only copies after the first are excluded from the cohort (exact_duplicate_extra_copy).
assumptions.non_product_lines: Postage, manual, carriage, bank charges, discounts, samples and fees are excluded from revenue/RFM (non_product_line).
assumptions.description_anomalies: Flagged for review and never automatically removed.
